title: Second-order overlap memory conditional on first-order state
hypothesis: The overlap of the draw two steps back (K[t-2]) adds predictive information about the next consecutive-draw overlap K[t], conditional on the most recent overlap K[t-1], beyond a first-order overlap-state model.

excluded_appended_rows.reason: Official VinciCasa archive and official bulletin page still list contest 314 as pending at preregistration time; this row is present in main commit 161273b but is not used.

source.official_verification: Official archive and bulletin listing checked 2026-11-11; latest official bulletin remained 2026-11-09. Third-party pages report 1,7,11,22,25, but third-party-only evidence is explicitly excluded.

models.M1: First-order categorical shrinkage: p1(k|a) = [alpha*q0(k) + C_a(k)] / [alpha + N_a], where C_a counts prior training transitions j with K_(j-1)=a and K_j=k.
models.M2: Second-order incremental model: p2(k|a,b) = [alpha*p1(k|a) + C_(a,b)(k)] / [alpha + N_(a,b)], where C_(a,b) counts prior training transitions j with K_(j-1)=a, K_(j-2)=b and K_j=k.
models.parameter_selection: None. alpha=200 fixed before scoring. M2 shrinks to the corresponding M1 state distribution; M1 shrinks to exact q0.

walk_forward.prior_only_rule: For target draw index t, construct K only from draws[0..t-1]. Train only on transition targets j=3..t-1; target K_t and later rows are unavailable to model construction.
walk_forward.no_tuning: No bandwidth, alpha, lag, subgroup, threshold, or split tuning. Validation is descriptive and is not used to alter the fixed model.

scoring.gain_sign: baseline loss minus model loss; positive values favor the model

inference.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni across exactly four preregistered Blind OOS endpoints.
inference.historical_blind_caveat: This historical blind slice has been exposed to prior SONAR overlap research (notably Q102) and is not a virgin prospective holdout.

integrity_checks: Archive dates unique and strictly increasing; each draw has five sorted distinct integers in 1..40.
The first 3,403 rows of data/storico_daily.csv reproduce the pinned analysis-prefix Git blob SHA-1; any appended rows are excluded.
src/data.json modelDraws matches the pinned 3,403-draw analysis prefix row-for-row.
Exact hypergeometric numerators sum to 658008 and probabilities sum to one.
All target indices use only strictly prior draws; initial training pair count is exactly 300.
M1 and M2 probability vectors are finite, nonnegative, and normalized for every target.
Future-mutation invariance: mutating target and all later draws does not alter forecasts at nine fixed cutoffs.
Synthetic second-order state test confirms M2 changes from M1 when lag-2 state contains signal; no-pair-data case collapses exactly to M1.
Fixed-seed block sign-flip and circular bootstrap are deterministic.
Report, validation, ledger, checkpoint, and manifest regenerate byte-for-byte.
guardrails: Research-only; do not change production scorer, immutable freezes, Q60, H101 or H102.
Do not use the unverified 2026-11-10 row currently present on main commit 161273b.
Do not infer official result from third-party-only sources.
No automatic merge, no model promotion, no change to PR #6, #7 or #8.
